unlockLines: Password recovery unlocked. A career in remembering things! This is bold hiring from a team that forgets its own fucking quota.
Security questions, beta. Your first pet was Productivity. It died here. Let us help somebody with a more promising memory.
Become the lord of forgotten passwords. Your crown is a sticky note and your kingdom has terrible spelling.
They forgot their password. You forgot why you came to work. At last, a customer relationship built on shared experience.
Account recovery! Finally, something in this office might recover. Management has officially ruled out your dignity.
